_comment: Bump binary_version whenever a change requires a NEW APK/EXE rather than a content-only update: Godot engine version, export template, permissions, native plugins, icons, anything outside res:// content, or a launcher sync that moves addons/launcher/build_info.gd -- it is autoload #1 and mounts the pack, so it is always the binary's copy. Everything else ships as a content pack. version_name is cosmetic.
